**Metadata & Calibre import**: everything Calibre's metadata editor did for your books, now in Bookbench. This release collects 1.3-beta1 to beta5.

## New

- **Metadata area.** Edit title, authors (separated with `&`), author sort, series and number (1,5 becomes 1.5), publisher, language, ISBN and tags. Apply with *Ctrl+Enter*, save with *Ctrl+S* (with backup, as everywhere). File names are never changed, so KOReader keeps reading positions and highlights.
- **Cover and blurb in the same area.** The cover sits right of the form (drag the divider for a wider or narrower panel), the blurb below it. *Apply* and *Discard* cover all three. Click the cover for a large view, click again to close it. The separate Blurbs and Covers areas are gone; their filters are in the Metadata list.
- **Own fields.** *Settings > Books > Metadata*: add any Calibre column (e.g. `#subtitle`), reorder or remove them. Number, yes/no and date columns are checked.
- **One-time import from a Calibre library.** *File > Import from Calibre library …* reads `metadata.db` (only reads, Calibre may stay open), matches books by Calibre ID, ISBN or title and author, and lists every differing field with a tick box. Own Calibre columns can be added as own fields in one go.
- **Comparison with Calibre and KOReader.** If `metadata.calibre` is found, differing values appear below the field (*← Calibre: …*, click to take over); values edited in KOReader itself are shown too. Can be switched off in *Settings > Books > Calibre*.
- **Complete ▾** in the toolbar: look up all missing blurbs or covers, or fill gaps from Calibre.
- **Own Google Books API key** (*Settings > Books > Blurbs*, optional, free): without one, Google Books often answers "quota exceeded". The look-up now says per source why nothing was found (quota used up, no blurb stored, not found), also below the blurb field.

## Changed

- **Pictograms instead of warning triangles.** The sidebar, the book lists and the new **Status column** of the library show every issue with its own symbol (speech bubble for no blurb, picture for no cover, question mark for questionable chapter names …). *Settings > General > Interface > Status symbols* hides single symbols per place. The sidebar gets a second line for an area when its symbols do not fit.
- **Library:** right-click a book to open it in Chapters, Metadata, the Preview or KOReader; what a double-click does is set in *Settings > General > Interface*. Status column can be hidden, dragged and sorted; new columns Publisher, Language and ISBN (hidden at first).
- **Resizable book lists** in Chapters, Metadata, Preview and Dictionary; names that do not fit are shown in full on hover.
- Smaller Windows setup.

## Fixed since beta5

- Hiding all sidebar symbols of an area brought back the red warning triangle.

## Note

Calibre writes its own metadata into a book when it sends it to the e-reader again. Change the values in Calibre as well, or stop sending from Calibre after the import.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy, or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
